_comment: Where the panel's Install button gets omodachi-core. One owner, one repository, one ref and the full commit that ref names; the bootstrap fetches the commit and checks it out detached, and refuses a ref whose commit differs. Only with an explicit --staging do $OMODACHI_CORE_SOURCE, $OMODACHI_CORE_REF and $OMODACHI_CORE_COMMIT (or --source/--ref/--commit) replace them, with a banner saying it is not the pinned core; the panel never passes --staging.
